title: Elevated errors across all models
excerpt: Claude's Status Page - Elevated errors across all models.
content_html:
Resolved

This issue has been resolved.

Posted Jul 29, 2026 - 22:36 UTC

Monitoring

From 12:45 PT / 19:45 UTC through to 1:26 PT / 21:26 UTC, we saw elevated rates of errors across Claude models. We have seen recovery in success rates across all models and are monitoring closely to ensure no further issues.

Posted Jul 29, 2026 - 22:20 UTC

Update

We are continuing to work to fully resolve issues resulting in elevated requests and latency to Claude models. At this time, we are seeing recovery across most models. We will provide an additional update as soon as possible.

Posted Jul 29, 2026 - 21:38 UTC

Identified

We have identified an issue resulting in elevated errors across multiple models, and are working to resolve this. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Posted Jul 29, 2026 - 20:33 UTC

Investigating

We are currently investigating this issue.

Posted Jul 29, 2026 - 19:49 UTC
